metadata.description: Claude Code mods by Akash Bhatnagar

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Stacked bar of the context window above or below the prompt, coloured by /context category, with rate limits, room before compaction and session length; /context-bar details for a full token breakdown

plugins.name: auto-handoff
plugins.description: Hands a long session off cleanly: at a context threshold Claude updates the docs and writes a handoff, the session compacts with its instructions, then a kickoff prompt carries on. Gives Claude a live context reading and a /wrap-up skill

plugins.name: pinned-notes
plugins.description: Pin notes to a session: /pin keeps them on show above the prompt and in Claude's system prompt, so they hold through compaction, come back on resume and can follow you into your next session

plugins.name: voice-profile
plugins.description: Drafts and edits messages in your own voice. A one-time setup learns how you write from the sources you tick (Gmail, Slack, LinkedIn posts, assignments), then plain requests like "reply to this recruiter" come out sounding like you

plugins.name: assessment-marker
plugins.description: Marks your uni assessments against the real rubric with High Distinction as the bar: a strict nine-section review, re-marks that catch regressions, a check before you submit, and it learns what each subject's marker cares about

plugins.name: session-archive
plugins.description: Keeps a copy of every Claude Code session before the 30-day cleanup, titles each one, searches them by meaning and shows your usage stats in a pane

plugins.name: course-correct
plugins.description: Adds a note for Claude when it goes round in circles on the same error, says it's done without checking, or slips into writing habits you've banned. Never blocks anything

plugins.name: tool-guards
plugins.description: Stops Claude editing files through the shell (so /rewind works), keeps its attribution out of your commits and PRs, and asks before a read that would eat a quarter of your remaining context

plugins.name: needs-you
plugins.description: Messages you on Slack when Claude has been waiting on you for a while (a finished turn, a permission prompt, a question); reply there and the session carries on

plugins.name: application-assistant
plugins.description: Job and internship applications: a daily role scan, eligibility checks against your own profile, application packs, form filling in Chrome for you to submit, a tracker kept up to date from your inbox, and reminders

plugins.name: auto-handoff-lite
plugins.description: Hands a long session off cleanly: /wrap-up updates the project's docs, writes a handoff file with a kickoff prompt, and gives you the exact /compact line to paste. /handoff resume picks the work back up in a fresh session (Code-free version of auto-handoff: install one or the other, not both.)

plugins.name: pinned-notes-lite
plugins.description: Pin notes, files and rules with /pin: they go in a marked block in the project's CLAUDE.local.md (or ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md with --global), so Claude loads them every session and after compaction until you /unpin them (Code-free version of pinned-notes: install one or the other, not both.)

plugins.name: voice-profile-lite
plugins.description: Drafts and edits messages in your own voice. /write setup learns how you write from the sources you tick (Gmail, Slack, LinkedIn posts, assignments), then plain requests like "reply to this recruiter" come out sounding like you. Code-free version. (Code-free version of voice-profile: install one or the other, not both.)

plugins.name: assessment-marker-lite
plugins.description: Marks your uni assessments against the real rubric with High Distinction as the bar: a strict nine-section review, re-marks that catch regressions, a check before you submit, and it learns what each subject's marker cares about. Code-free version: skills only (Code-free version of assessment-marker: install one or the other, not both.)

plugins.name: session-archive-lite
plugins.description: /sessions: copy your Claude Code sessions into an archive folder before the 30-day cleanup (when you ask), title and index them, search them by meaning or plain text, print usage stats, and raise cleanupPeriodDays with your OK (Code-free version of session-archive: install one or the other, not both.)

plugins.name: course-correct-lite
plugins.description: Code-free version. A check at the end of each reply sends Claude back when it says code works without having run it, or uses a stock phrase like "You're absolutely right". /coach keeps your own bans, comment limit and reply language, and offers a CLAUDE.md block with the rules, including stopping after the same error twice (Code-free version of course-correct: install one or the other, not both.)

plugins.name: tool-guards-lite
plugins.description: Stops Claude editing files through the shell (so /rewind works) and keeps its attribution out of your commits and PRs. Code-free version: a small model check on each shell command, plus /guards for settings (Code-free version of tool-guards: install one or the other, not both.)

plugins.name: application-assistant-lite
plugins.description: Job and internship applications, code-free: /apply rundown with what's due, role scans, eligibility checks against your own profile, application packs, form filling in Chrome for you to submit, and a tracker kept up to date from your inbox (Code-free version of application-assistant: install one or the other, not both.)
